$comment: Third-party packages a @zerotal package may list in `dependencies`, each with the reason every app installing that package needs it. Anything else is an optional peer, written in-house, or a devDependency. Read by scripts/deps-check.ts; the public version is the Dependencies table in docs/support-policy.md, and the two must agree. The rules: docs/package-development.md#dependencies.

@zerotal/core.@js-temporal/polyfill: Carbon is built on Temporal, which Bun ships natively only from 1.4. Transitional: it goes when the supported floor reaches a Bun with Temporal.

@zerotal/flow.typescript: The ahead-of-time component compiler reads the TypeScript syntax tree, which Bun's transpiler does not expose.

@zerotal/flow-ui.tailwind-merge: Resolving conflicting Tailwind classes needs Tailwind's own class grammar; a reimplementation would drift from every Tailwind release.
